description: File types of Primula Studio: which files of a project the Files panel shows and how they open. Built in; the user file (~/.config/primula-docs/file-types.json) and the project file (.primula-studio/file-types.json) add types or override them by pattern. open: editor — the text editor of Studio; preview — the PDF preview; system — the program of the desktop; command — the command below (%f the file, %d its folder, %r the path from the project root; not allowed in a project file).
